event.reason: Retrospective source-only review of the July 1, 2026 parent corporate closing, not a new issuance or current capitalization estimate. Securitize Corp. (formerly Securitize Holdings, Inc.) is distinct from its operating subsidiary Securitize I, Inc. (formerly Securitize, Inc.). The parent 10-Q cover reports 163265685 common shares issued and outstanding as of August 13, 2026; Note 5 reports the same count at the July 1 closing. The July 1 count includes 1800000 sponsor shares subject to vesting, forfeiture and transfer restrictions; do not add them again. It excludes up to 6250000 conditional additional earnout shares, 16321869 shares reserved for incentive/employee purchase plans, 3711658 warrant underlying shares and 3681510 option/RSU underlying shares. These are separate disclosed capacities or conditional rights, not completed issuances or a mechanically additive fully diluted share count. Current exercises, vesting, earnout triggers and transfers remain unverified. June 30 financial statements concern the pre-combination holding company: 10000 common shares and USD 1 petty cash are not post-closing consolidated shares or current parent cash/debt. Existing subsidiary revenue cannot be silently combined with that pre-closing balance sheet. The July 31 S-1 resale registration covers 151568524 shares, not all newly issued shares. Exhibit 5.1 separates 140768250 already issued resale shares, 3711658 warrant underlying shares and up to 7088616 earnout-category shares. The opinion's earnout category and the 10-Q's 6250000 additional-share maximum are not reconciled here. Retain the S-1 indexed offering-table excerpt of 314834209 post-offering shares as unresolved context, not a verified current or fully diluted denominator; only the indexed excerpt was reviewed because the full S-1 exceeds the web reader size limit. Do not double-count registered resale shares. The opinion is dated July 30 and calls the S-1 filed July 30; EDGAR accepted July 30 at 20:11:36 but lists filing July 31. Preserve both dates; source availability uses the July 31 index date. No synchronized price, current consolidated cash/debt, market cap or EV is established. No financial inputs, assumptions, formulas, graph edges, model periods or thesis states are changed; no new thesis period, promotion or personal investability clearance.
